plain: To make or become alike; to blend people or things into a larger whole.

webster.text: To bring to a likeness; to cause to resemble.

more.text: To convert into a like substance; as, food is assimilated by conversion into animal substances, flesh, chyle, blood, &c.
To be converted into a like substance.

example.quote: It can harmonize, assimilate, and protect the several parts and members, and extend the benefit of its foresight and precautions to each.
